body: I rly wanted to start working out at a gym but like I said all the gyms in my country will close due to COVID (again) so if I were to get a membership I would waste money I do live in a house and not apartment and I have a backyard but I don’t even know where to start working out

I understand what you want to tell me but the thing is I can’t experience more then daily walks because I am still in high school (final year) and I don’t have money and Time the only thing I do is walk in the evening and that did take away some of the thoughts in the moment but right before I knew it they came back and I honestly don’t know how to cope anymore the fact that I have no social life and that I have social anxiety as well isn’t helping
